movelist.name: Moonblast
movelist.effect: Moonblast lowers the target’s Special Attack by 1 Combat Stage on 15+.

movelist.name: Magic Coat
movelist.effect: If the user is about to get a hit by a Move that does not have a Damage Dice Roll, they may use Magic Coat as an Interrupt. The Interrupted Move’s user is treated as if they were the target of their own Move, with the user of Magic Coat as the user.

movelist.name: Night Daze
movelist.effect: Night Daze lowers the target’s Accuracy by -1 on 13+.

movelist.name: Moonlight
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Point value. If it is Sunny, the user gains 2/3 of its full Hit Point value. If it is Rainy, Sand Storming or Hailing the user gains 1/4 of their full Hit Point value.

movelist.name: Shadow Ball
movelist.effect: Shadow Ball lowers the foe’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+.

movelist.name: Air Slash
movelist.effect: Air Slash Flinches the target on 15+.

abilities.name: Shadow Shield
abilities.effect: While at full Hit Points, the user resists all damage one step further. Defensive.

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.effect: The user gains a +2 Bonus to Stealth Checks, does not trigger Hazards, Blessings cannot be activated in response to its actions, and the user may bypass the effects of the move Substitute.

abilities.name: Fade Away
abilities.effect: The user becomes Invisible until the beginning of their next turn, and may immediately Shift. This Ability may be activated as an Interrupt when hit by a Physical attack; the user may declare the use of Fade Away to avoid all damage and/or effects of the move. Defensive.
